capabilities: Lint markdown files in real time with inline diagnostics
Fix issues from hover tooltips with one click
Fix all issues automatically on save
Configure rules via settings or a .rumdl.toml config file with extends
Show the issue count in the status bar
extras: Pending review on the Obsidian community site; install via BRAT until approval. Config targets outside the vault only work on desktop; on mobile the plugin falls back to its own settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in markdown style checking, so inconsistent headings, spacing, and list formatting accumulate across notes.

relations.evidence: Fast markdown linting for Obsidian using rumdl - a Rust-based markdown linter compiled to WebAssembly.

summary: Markdown linter that runs 50+ style rules in real time, offers one-click fixes from tooltips, format on save, and a status bar issue count.
